components.css: .ds-control { display: block; width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-control svg { display: block; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #F4F6F2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-control:active { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-face { position: relative; width: 225px; height: 225px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 50%; background: #000000; color: #F4F6F2; font-family: sans-serif; } .ds-face .ds-control { position: absolute; top: 43%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-face .ds-left-plus { left: 12.5%; } .ds-face .ds-right-plus { left: 87.5%; } .ds-face .ds-undo { left: 50%; top: 82.5%; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-face .ds-control:active { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-face .ds-label { position: absolute; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: "tnum"; } .ds-face .ds-points { top: 43%; width: 25%; height: 66px; font-family: "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-stretch: condensed; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-face .ds-left-points { left: 33.2%; } .ds-face .ds-right-points { left: 66.8%; } .ds-face .ds-separator { left: 50%; top: 43%; width: 7.5%; height: 40px; color: #8B938D; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-face .ds-divider { position: absolute; left: 25%; top: calc(57.5% - 0.375px); width: 50%; height: 0.75px; background: #343936; } .ds-face .ds-games { left: 50%; top: 65.5%; width: 76%; height: 32px; gap: 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-face .ds-completed { color: #929B94; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-face .ds-match-number { left: 50%; top: 18.5%; width: 65%; height: 22px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-face .ds-match-date { left: 50%; top: 27.5%; width: 70%; height: 20px; font-size: 11px; color: #929B94; }

components.name: Delete preview
components.description: A red semicircle rises over the score to the screen midpoint. Hold it there for one second to confirm deletion with an 80ms vibration. The deleted score sinks and fades into the trash before the remaining match appears as the semicircle recedes. Releasing early or pulling back cancels.
components.css: .ds-delete-face { position: relative; width: 225px; height: 225px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; background: #000000; } .ds-delete-background { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; width: 225px; height: 225px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FF6B6B; } .ds-delete-face svg { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 77%; width: 48px; height: 48px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }

narrative.overview: Condensed bold point scores and filled graphite plus controls lead a black watch face. A small match number and creation date sit above; current games, completed sets, and a gray undo arrow sit below. The composition supports a quick glance and a tap on court.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed point numerals hold the strongest visual emphasis.
Fixed touch areas surround compact artwork. The match number and date occupy the space above the points.

rules.name: The score hierarchy rule
rules.body: Points lead; current games are larger and brighter than completed sets. Keep the multiplication separator smaller and dimmer than the points.

rules.name: The touch area rule
rules.body: Keep the fixed control dimensions in the frontmatter when adjusting screen proportions. The artwork is smaller than its touch area.

rules.name: Swipe feedback
rules.body: Track the finger when navigating matches or raising the red deletion semicircle. A horizontal swipe settles in 150ms; an incomplete swipe returns in 160ms. Up raises the semicircle to the screen midpoint. Hold there continuously for one second to delete with an 80ms vibration. The deleted score moves down 30% of the viewport and fades out over 180ms with cubic ease-in. The remaining match then fades in as the semicircle recedes over 220ms with cubic ease-out. Releasing early or pulling back cancels. Respect disabled system animations without shortening the confirmation delay.

dos: Do preserve the filled plus controls and condensed bold points as the scoring screen's main row.
Do retain native text fitting, tabular figures, and fixed touch targets when adjusting proportions.
Do keep secondary scoring and undo visually quieter than the points.
donts: Don't add names, menus, banners, extra controls, or a completion screen to this scoring view.
Don't draw a hardware bezel inside the app.
